notes: Meant as a late failure, but expect it to fail fast. Under BuildKit (the default builder for docker build on ubuntu-latest), COPY sources are checksummed once the build context loads, independently of the steps before them. So a missing source should fail within seconds even though this COPY comes after pip install and the model download, and any step already running is marked CANCELED: 'ERROR: failed to solve: failed to compute cache key: failed to calculate checksum of ref ...: "/apii": not found'. Same signature as inj-022; only the path differs. If the recorded log instead shows the pip install and model download completing first, correct this note. The destination ./api/ is right; only the source is misspelled.
